title: Engineering professions Saudization raised to 30% (46 professions, SAR 8,000 wage floor)
authority: HRSD with Ministry of Municipalities and Housing
scope: Private and non-profit establishments with 5+ workers in the 46 engineering professions; Saudi must earn at least SAR 8,000 to count
summary: HRSD raised the Saudization rate for 46 engineering professions (architect, power, industrial, electronics, marine, etc.) to 30% with an SAR 8,000 minimum wage; enforcement started 30 June 2026 after a grace period.
notes: Announcement date: Argaam dated 2026-01-04; the HRSD page shows 21 Jan 2026 (could be page date) and states the decision date 31/12/2025. Enforcement date 2026-06-30 from HRSD implementation notice (also Saudi Gazette/Zawya 2026-06-30, Argaam 1916603). Distinct from the 'technical engineering' (94 professions) decision.

title: Procurement professions Saudization raised to 70% (12 professions)
scope: Private establishments with 3+ workers in the 12 procurement/logistics professions
summary: HRSD raised the Saudization rate for 12 procurement professions (procurement manager, tender specialist, warehouse manager, e-commerce specialist...) to 70%, enforced from 31 May 2026.
notes: Same announcement as engineering (HRSD page dated 21 Jan 2026 vs Argaam 2026-01-04). HRSD states decision effective 30/11/2025 then implementation commenced 31 May 2026 (HRSD notice). Teamed also lists 31 May 2026, 3+ workers.

title: Marketing and sales professions Saudization raised to 60%
scope: Private establishments with 3+ workers in 10 marketing roles and 9 sales roles; marketing wage floor SAR 5,500
summary: Two decisions raised the Saudi share to 60% for marketing (10 occupations) and sales (9 roles) with a three-month delay, implemented 19 April 2026.
notes: Contradiction: KPMG flash alert says 'effective 19 January 2026'; Argaam says effective Jan 19 but implementation three months later; HRSD implementation notice says effective 19 April 2026. Used 19 April as enforcement date. Min wage SAR 5,500 stated for marketing (Argaam, KPMG); sales wage floor not verified.

title: Housing supervisor role reserved 100% for Saudis
authority: HRSD with Ministry of Municipalities and Housing
scope: Establishments operating shared accommodation for 20+ residents; Saudi supervisor must earn SAR 5,000+
summary: The housing supervisor role in collective housing for 20 or more residents became 100% Saudi-only from 1 Feb 2026.
notes: No HRSD primary page read. Announcement date = Fragomen alert date (8 Jan 2026); true ministry announcement may be earlier. Two law-firm sources agree on 1 Feb 2026.

title: Dental professions Saudization phase 2: 55%
scope: Private establishments with 3+ workers in dental specialties; Saudi dentist counts at SAR 9,000+ GOSI wage with SCFHS accreditation
summary: Phase two of the dental Saudization decision took effect, raising the Saudi share from 45% to 55%.
notes: Underlying decision is Ministerial Resolution 103107 of 26 Jan 2025; 2026-01-27 is the phase-2 launch announcement (Argaam, Clyde & Co also confirm).

title: Accounting professions Saudization phase 2: 50%
authority: HRSD with Ministry of Commerce (SOCPA accreditation)
scope: Private establishments with 5+ workers in 21 listed accounting job titles; Saudi counts at SAR 6,000 (bachelor) or SAR 4,500 (diploma)
summary: The accounting Saudization rate rose from 40% to 50% on 27 October 2026 under Ministerial Resolution 103108 (progressive path to 70%).
notes: Decision dated 26 Jan 2025; 2026 event is a scheduled step. Contradiction: HRSD manual snippet says progression to 70% 'over five years starting 27/10/2025' while thejobseek says 70% by 2028. Wage floors from thejobseek/noqta (secondary). No 2026 HRSD news item read for this step.

title: Sports centres and gyms: 15% Saudization for 12 coaching roles
scope: Licensed men's and women's sports centres/gyms with 4+ workers in 12 coach/supervisor roles
summary: 15% of 12 coaching and supervision roles in gyms must be Saudi from 18 November 2026.
notes: Announced before 2026 (24 Nov 2025 per strongyes.co, single secondary; HRSD page metadata dated 2025-12-21); effective date is inside the tracker window and 3 days after 15 Nov. HRSD page text not read in detail beyond its title; rate/date/threshold from Fragomen, Clyde, Envoy.

title: Nitaqat Mutawar new three-year phase (2026-2028), 340,000+ jobs
scope: All private establishments (bands by activity); 340,000 additional jobs targeted
summary: HRSD launched a new three-year phase of the Nitaqat Mutawar programme aiming to localize more than 340,000 additional private-sector jobs.
notes: Effective date not given by HRSD ('starting in 2026'). Contradiction: Middle East Briefing says 16 April 2026, a LinkedIn post says 26 April, others 'April 2026'. Procedural guide with 2026/2027/2028 constants published January 2026 (Tamimi cites 22 Jan 2026; rw.sa 'January 2026'; not verified at source). Removal of the Yellow band is reported only by secondary sources (Middle East Briefing, Element, Solvait), not seen in the HRSD text read.

title: Nitaqat counts only Saudi contracts documented on Qiwa
scope: All private establishments subject to Nitaqat
summary: From 15 April 2026 only Saudis whose employment contracts are electronically documented on Qiwa count in Nitaqat Saudization percentages.
notes: Announcement date not read on the HRSD page; earliest dated evidence is a LinkedIn post of 2026-03-16 (so announced on or before that). Documentation-rate targets 85% by 30 Apr and 90% by 30 Jun 2026 appear in one LinkedIn post only (unverified). A Sept 2026 clarification limits counted contracts (HRME Economic Times) not verified at source.

title: 69 administrative support professions reserved 100% for Saudis
authority: HRSD (Ministerial Decision updating the Procedural Guide)
scope: Private establishments with at least one worker in the 69 listed titles (HR, recruitment, PR, government relations, secretaries, receptionists, logistics clerks...)
summary: HRSD added 69 administrative support professions to the 100% Saudization list: 19 apply immediately and 50 after a six-month grace period.
notes: Effective 5 April 2026 applies to the 19 immediately covered titles (Fragomen, Saudi Gazette 2026-04-06, Argaam 2026-04-06). HRSD text read says '69 professions effective 5 April 2026' without the split; the 19/50 split comes from Fragomen/Saudi Gazette headline. Min wage not verified. See grace-period entry for the 50.

title: Grace period ends for 50 of the 69 administrative support professions
scope: Private establishments with one or more worker in the 50 deferred titles (receptionist, shipping clerk, PR specialist, recruitment specialist...)
summary: The six-month grace period for the remaining 50 administrative support professions ended, making them 100% Saudi-only.
notes: CONTRADICTION: DLA Piper (2026-10-21), BAL and AYK say 4 Oct 2026; Fragomen (April) and TAS Outsourcing say 5 Oct 2026. Used 4 Oct (post-event reports); HRSD primary page for the end-of-grace date not found.

title: Tourism localization phase 1: 28 professions (4 at 100%, 12 at 70%, 12 at 50%)
scope: Tourism establishments (licensed) with 1+ worker in the covered titles
summary: HRSD announced first-phase implementation of tourism Saudization: receptionist, hotel receptionist, telephone operator and information clerk at 100%, 12 roles at 70% and 12 at 50%, effective 22 April 2026.
notes: Underlying decision: Ministerial Resolution 137440 of 21 Apr 2025 (41 professions, three phases). 'Announced' = 3 May 2026 implementation notice (page date shown 3 May 2026; Kathmandu Post confirms notice of May 3). Clyde & Co separately cites a 40% general tourism quota effective 22 June 2026 (Ministry of Tourism policy) - not reconciled with the HRSD phase structure; 'one or more workers' scope from Kathmandu Post only.

title: Project management professions Saudization raised to 70%
authority: HRSD with Ministry of Municipalities and Housing
scope: Private establishments with 3+ workers in project management manager/engineer/specialist roles
summary: HRSD set a 70% Saudization rate for project management professions, effective 14 February 2027.
notes: Contradiction on date: HRSD statement says announced Sunday 16 Aug 2026 and Argaam is dated 16/08; EY and the procedural guide cite Ministerial Decision 41454 dated 13 Aug 2026. Announcement = 2026-08-16, decision date = 2026-08-13.

title: Nitaqat full-count wage threshold rises to SAR 5,000
authority: Royal directive (King Salman, on Crown Prince proposal), implemented by HRSD/Qiwa and HRDF
scope: All private-sector Saudi employees (full-time, part-time, flexible, student part-time, disabled) counted under Nitaqat
summary: From 25 April 2027 a Saudi must earn SAR 5,000 a month to count as one full worker in Nitaqat (currently SAR 4,000).
notes: SPA gives only relative timing ('six months after the measures take effect', then 12 months later). Absolute dates 25 Apr 2027 / 25 Apr 2028 come from HRDF, EY, KPMG, Gulf News, Saudi Times (Qiwa explanation). Argaam relays the relative wording. The half-count mechanics (4,000-4,999 = half) come from The Saudi Times citing Qiwa (secondary). Rules per worker category to be announced later (Vice Minister Abu Ithnain, Argaam 2026-10-26).

title: Nitaqat full-count wage threshold rises to SAR 6,000
authority: Royal directive (King Salman), implemented by HRSD/Qiwa and HRDF
scope: All private-sector Saudi employees counted under Nitaqat
summary: From 25 April 2028 the full-count threshold rises again to SAR 6,000 a month.
notes: Same sourcing note as the 5,000 phase. Not a general minimum wage: employers are not forced to pay more, lower pay just counts less.

title: HRDF Employment Support minimum qualifying wage rises to SAR 5,000 then 6,000
scope: New Employment Support applications; existing applications follow a staggered schedule
summary: HRDF raised the minimum monthly wage for jobs eligible for Employment Support from SAR 4,000 to 5,000 on 25 Apr 2027 and 6,000 on 25 Apr 2028.
notes: Announcement date 29 Oct 2026 per HRDF page; Enterprise says HRDF announced 'last week'. Terms for existing applications were truncated in the page text read. Phase 2 effective 2028-04-25.

title: 94 technical engineering professions Saudization raised to 35%
authority: HRSD with Ministry of Municipalities and Housing
scope: Private establishments with 5+ workers in 94 technical engineering professions, rate computed at establishment level
summary: The Saudi share for 94 technical engineering professions (engineering technicians, surveyors, maintenance technicians, drafters) rises from 30% to 35% from 9 May 2027.
notes: Confirmed by SPA, the HRSD Arabic press release (Sunday 8 Nov 2026), Argaam, Zawya, EIG, BAL. Prior 30% rate in force since 27 Jul 2025 (Zawya). Wage floor for this decision not found.
